benefits.name: Cellular Telephone Protection
benefits.description: Up to $600 of cell phone protection against damage or theft when the monthly cell phone bill is paid with the card.
benefits.terms: Up to $600 per approved claim, subject to a $25 deductible; maximum two paid claims per 12-month period. Cell phone bills must be paid with an eligible Wells Fargo consumer credit card. Does not cover phones that are lost (mysteriously disappear).

benefits.name: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Reimbursement for covered damage or theft of a rental car paid for with the card.
benefits.terms: Pay the full cost of the rental with the card and decline the rental company's collision coverage. Certain vehicles are not covered; a maximum benefit amount and other restrictions apply (see the Wells Fargo Guide to Benefits).

benefits.name: Travel and Emergency Assistance Services
benefits.description: Emergency assistance while traveling anywhere in the world.

benefits.name: Roadside Dispatch
benefits.description: 24/7 roadside dispatch service (e.g. towing) with no membership required.

benefits.name: Emergency Cash and Card Replacement
benefits.description: Emergency cash advance disbursement or card replacement within one to three business days.

benefits.name: Visa Signature Concierge
benefits.description: Complimentary 24/7 Visa Signature Concierge for event tickets, travel bookings, dinner reservations, and more.
